name: Ramp
description: Corporate card, expense management, and financial automation platform providing APIs and MCP servers for spend management and bill pay.

evidence.claim: Ramp provides developer APIs for spend management, bills, and payment processing.
Ramp offers an official MCP server for LLM integration.
Ramp supports OAuth2 authorization framework along with client ID and client secret credentials.

notes: Ramp provides a developer API as well as an official MCP server (ramp_mcp) using an ephemeral sqlite database for LLM analysis.
